title: Natural stalk derived-extension comparison with K-flat equation
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square of schemes, with chosen derived categories of module sheaves. Let z∈X′ and R,A,B,C be the actual stalk rings, with ρ:A→A⊗_R B→C the composite stalk ring map [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let L:D(A)→D(C), ε:Qh⋙L→extendScalars(ρ)⋙Qh be a universal left-derived scalar-extension pair. Use the exact derived stalk functors [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. There exists a natural transformation stalk(g′z)⋙L→derivedPullback(g′)⋙stalk(z) satisfying the following equation. For every K-flat sheaf complex P on X with invertible recorded pullback counit, L of the inverse old exact-stalk factor followed by the component at Q(P) equals, in order, L of the inverse Q/Qh factor, ε at the stalk complex, Qh of the ordinary scalar-extension homotopy factor, the new Q/Qh factor, Q of tensorStalkIso, the inverse new exact-stalk factor, and the new derived stalk of the inverse pullback counit. This is the exact derived-morphism equation of the Lean signature.

proof.text: Use the specified restriction equation for tensorMap and the degreewise equation of exists_tensorStalkIso. Naturality of the chosen module pullback-stalk isomorphism, together with naturality of equality transport in extension of scalars, proves tensorStalkIso_naturality for chain maps.

Install the sheaf tensor, closed and Grothendieck structures and schemeModule_hasFunctorialFlatResolution, giving the K-flat left derivability structure. Obtain from derivedPullback_spec a left-derived tensor-pullback counit epsilon_0 which is invertible on sheaf K-flat complexes. Identify its underived functor with the recorded tensorPullback by its object and map equations. The recorded composition counit and epsilon_0 are universal pairs for the same functor, so leftDerivedNatIso gives a counit-compatible automorphism of derivedPullback. For a categorical K-flat homotopy object choose a complex representative and translate its K-flat property using kFlat_iff_preserves_acyclic. The compatibility equation expresses the recorded counit component as the isomorphism component followed by epsilon_0. Thus it too is invertible on the K-flat left derivability structure. Apply LocalizerMorphism.isLeftDerivedFunctor_comp_of_isLeftDerivabilityStructure to postcompose with comparisonDerivedStalk, obtaining the universal property for the whiskered recorded counit. No separate tensor-pullback quasi-isomorphism preservation result is used.

On complexes compose L of the original exact-stalk factor, the supplied scalar-extension counit, Q of tensorStalkIso, and the inverse new exact-stalk factor. The Q/Qh and ordinary homotopy-category factors in the requested formula have identity components by their quotient-lift construction. Naturality of the exact-stalk factors and of the scalar-extension counit, and step 1, prove naturality of this composite. Quotient.natTransLift descends it to the homotopy category. Functor.leftDerivedLift for the universal pair in step 2 constructs j. Its leftDerived_fac_app equation, followed by cancellation of the assumed invertible pullback counit and the old stalk factor, is exactly the required representative equation. This uses no separate roof or common-refinement theorem and asserts no invertibility of j.

theorem exists_stalkDerivedExtensionComparisonTransformation (z : X') :
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (C z))
    ∀ (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (C z)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
          ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp
            (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z)))).mapHomotopyCategory
              (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      (hL : L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} (A g' z)) (.up ℤ))),
    ∃ j : comparisonDerivedStalk X (g' z) ⋙ L ⟶
        derivedPullback g' ⋙ comparisonDerivedStalk X' z,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))),
        L.map ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (g' z)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app P) ≫
            j.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
          L.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.map
              (((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
                ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp
                  (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z)))).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors
                  (.up ℤ)).hom.app
                (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso (ModuleCat.{u} (C z))).hom.app
              (tensorComplex f f' g g' sq z P) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z P).hom ≫
            (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X'.toRingedSpace z).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
                (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
            (comparisonDerivedStalk X' z).map
              (inv ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
